current_p1_ru: Ганс Ланда, Амон Гёт, Дарт Вейдер, Волдеморт. Тебя интересуют злодеи, в которых читается реальное зло истории. Они говорят о тоталитаризме, о войне, о том, что обычные люди могут стать чудовищами.
current_p1_en:
Hans Landa, Amon Göth, Darth Vader, Voldemort. You're interested in villains in whom real historical evil reads. They speak about totalitarianism, about war, about how ordinary people can become monsters.
This works because you have an interest in history. Through cinematic villains you analyze real mechanisms of evil.
People sometimes don't share the feeling: "it's just a movie". A movie through which you understand 20th-century events better.
What's worth knowing: historical evil on screen simplifies. Real evil is often less "effective" — it's everyday and systemic. Learn to see that aspect too. Otherwise you look for villainy with a face, while real damage often comes from faceless mass cooperation.

current_p1_ru: Рой Батти, Ганнибал Лектер, Антон Чигур, Джокер Феникса. Тебе ближе антагонисты, у которых есть философия. Они не просто «плохие» — они объясняют, почему мир устроен так, как они его видят.
current_p1_en:
Roy Batty, Hannibal Lecter, Anton Chigurh, Phoenix's Joker. You're closer to antagonists who have philosophy. They're not just "bad" — they explain why the world is built the way they see it.
This works because you love when evil reflects. It lifts a film from the level of "entertainment" to "thought".
People are sometimes surprised: "do you agree with Lecter?". I don't agree — I hear. Different things.
What's worth knowing: philosophizing villains are dangerous because sometimes they tell the truth. And that doesn't make them less evil; just real. Learn to perceive complexly. Evil that thinks becomes a mirror — you see yourself in it. That's a useful experience as long as you stay outside the frame.

current_p1_ru: Disco Elysium, Journey, Hollow Knight, Nier: Automata. Тебе нравятся игры, которые работают как искусство. Не «развлекают», а оставляют след — настроение, мысль, образ.
current_p1_en:
Disco Elysium, Journey, Hollow Knight, Nier: Automata. You like games that work as art. Not "entertain" but leave a trace — a mood, a thought, an image.
This works because you see games as a medium for serious ideas. Most don't believe in that potential; you do.
People sometimes don't share the feeling: "that's boring, nothing happens". It happens — inside.
What's worth knowing: arthouse games need a different tempo. If you're used to shooters, the meditative Journey will read as "nothing". Learn to switch modes — it's a different genre of experience.

current_p1_ru: Dark Souls, Hollow Knight, Nier, Hades. Тебе нужны игры, которые не ведут за руку. Ты падаешь, встаёшь, изучаешь систему, и побеждаешь не из-за читов, а из-за мастерства.
current_p1_en:
Dark Souls, Hollow Knight, Nier, Hades. You need games that don't hold your hand. You fall, get up, study the system, and win not from cheats but from mastery.
This works because you have pleasure from overcoming. Most modern games try "not to frustrate"; these — the opposite, demand pain, and that's their high.
People sometimes don't get it: "why play if it's so hard?". Because after winning you feel what easy games simply don't have.
What's worth knowing: the genre takes time. If you don't have 30+ hours for one game, don't start. Better to delay than to abandon mid-way.

current_p1_ru: Red Dead Redemption 2, The Last of Us, GTA: San Andreas, God of War. Тебе нравятся миры на грани — после катастрофы, на фронтире, в эпохе хаоса. И ты в этих мирах живёшь.
current_p1_en:
Red Dead Redemption 2, The Last of Us, GTA: San Andreas, God of War. You like worlds on the edge — after catastrophe, on the frontier, in eras of chaos. And you live in those worlds.
This works because you have an interest in extreme states of society. Calm plots bore you; you need something around you to be falling apart or not yet built.
People are sometimes surprised: "you're always in these dark worlds". Not dark — real. There's more life in them than in the sterile ones.
What's worth knowing: post-apoc games carry emotional weight. After Last of Us you need to switch. Learn to alternate with lighter ones — otherwise the heaviness accumulates.

current_p1_ru: Minecraft, Stardew Valley, Undertale, Journey. Игры, к которым ты возвращаешься не за адреналином, а за покоем. Где можно строить, выращивать, исследовать без давления.
current_p1_en:
Minecraft, Stardew Valley, Undertale, Journey. Games you return to not for adrenaline but for peace. Where you can build, grow, explore without pressure.
This works because you have a need for slow games. Modern life is fast already; in games you look for pause, not acceleration.
People sometimes say: "those are kids' games". Not kids' — simple. And in simplicity there's a depth most people miss.
What's worth knowing: cozy games are great rest but not a challenge. If you only play them, you never grow as a gamer. Learn to alternate with ones that throw a challenge back at you.

current_p1_ru: Hades, Hollow Knight, Undertale, Dark Souls. Тебе нравятся игры, в которых нужно проходить заново. Не «один раз и всё»; механика и нарратив раскрываются через повторение.
current_p1_en:
Hades, Hollow Knight, Undertale, Dark Souls. You like games that ask you to do it again. Not "once and done"; mechanics and narrative reveal through repetition.
This works because you have patience. Most people want to finish in one run; you understand repetition has its own depth.
People sometimes don't get it: "you died again? and starting over?". Again. And every time I know a little more.
What's worth knowing: "again and again" is a special temperament. If you're impatient by nature, these games will break you. Learn to tell — is this your school, or just a trend? For some, the genre's loop is meditative; for others, torture.

current_p1_ru: Ведьмак, Скайрим, GTA: San Andreas, RDR 2. Тебе нравятся игры, в которых ты можешь идти куда хочешь. Сюжет — это одна линия; вокруг неё — целая жизнь, и ты ныряешь в неё.
current_p1_en:
Witcher, Skyrim, GTA: San Andreas, RDR 2. You like games where you can go wherever you want. The plot is one line; around it — a whole life, and you dive into it.
This works because you love freedom of exploration. One route isn't enough; you need turn-offs, and to take them productively.
People sometimes get tired of your tempo: "two hours in one village?". Two. There's a lot there.
What's worth knowing: open world can become a trap. If you're constantly distracted by side quests, you may never finish the main plot for years. Learn to balance the wandering with progressing — otherwise the freedom becomes a cage of incompletion.

items_in_category: Чип и Дейл спешат на помощь
current_p1_ru: Ну, погоди!, Смешарики, Скуби-Ду, Чип и Дейл. Ты вырос(-ла) на смеси советского и западного. И помнишь оба мира — и хитрого волка из Союзмультфильма, и беспечных бурундучков-спасателей.
current_p1_en:
Nu, pogodi!, Smeshariki, Scooby-Doo, Chip 'n Dale. You grew up on a mix of Soviet and Western. And you remember both worlds — the cunning wolf from Soyuzmultfilm and the carefree Rescue Rangers.
This works because you have a cultural duality. Most people are either "only ours" or "only Western"; you understand the best is the combination.
Other people sometimes are surprised: "you watch Smeshariki even now?". Sometimes. They still hold up.
What's worth knowing: Soviet animation had a depth modern works rarely touch. If you have kids, don't deprive them of it. They'll appreciate it, even if it doesn't look as polished as Pixar.

items_in_category: Чип и Дейл спешат на помощь
current_p1_ru: Утиные истории, Чип и Дейл, Гравити Фолс, Аватар: Легенда об Аанге. Тебя цепляли мультфильмы с настоящими сюжетами. Не «гэги»; а истории с героями, миром, развитием.
current_p1_en:
DuckTales, Chip 'n Dale, Gravity Falls, Avatar: The Last Airbender. What got you were cartoons with real plots. Not gags. Stories with heroes, a world, growth.
This works because you love narrative. Even as a kid, "funny" wasn't enough; you needed a story.
Other people sometimes are surprised: "you still love Avatar?". Still. It's one of the best animated series of all time.
What's worth knowing: the best animated series survive a rewatch decades later. Watching Gravity Falls at 30 is different from watching it at 12. Learn to come back. It gives a second understanding.

items_in_category: Чип и Дейл спешат на помощь
current_p1_ru: Симпсоны, Южный парк, Футурама, Рик и Морти. Ты любишь мультсериалы, которые не для детей. Острая социальная критика, абсурд, моральная неоднозначность.
current_p1_en:
The Simpsons, South Park, Futurama, Rick and Morty. You love animated series that aren't for kids. Sharp social criticism, absurdity, moral ambiguity.
This works because you have critical thinking. These cartoons aren't "entertainment" — they're a commentary on the era.
Other people sometimes don't share the feeling: "South Park is just edgy". Edgy. And smart. And accurate. Those are different things.
What's worth knowing: these series age unevenly. The Simpsons of the '90s — genius; the modern ones — flat. Learn to watch by season, not back to back. The strongest episodes are usually in the first 5 seasons of any of them.

items_in_category: Чип и Дейл спешат на помощь
current_p1_ru: Аватар: Легенда об Аанге, Гравити Фолс, Время приключений, Покемон. Тебя цепляли мультфильмы с волшебством. Не «реальный мир со смешными ситуациями»; а другой мир со своими правилами.
current_p1_en:
Avatar, Gravity Falls, Adventure Time, Pokémon. What got you were cartoons with magic. Not "the real world with funny situations"; another world with its own rules.
This works because you love fantasy. A purely realistic plot was boring to you; you needed magic.
Other people sometimes don't get it: "Pokémon is primitive". Maybe. But the world of Pokémon is huge, and many adults find it pleasant to come back to.
What's worth knowing: fantasy cartoons for kids often hold serious adult themes. Avatar is about genocide, imperialism, forgiveness. Learn to see those layers. They're there even if the heroes are cute.

items_in_category: Чип и Дейл спешат на помощь
current_p1_ru: Том и Джерри, Скуби-Ду, Ну, погоди!, Утиные истории. Ты любишь классику. Не современные мультфильмы; а те, что смотрели и твои родители — и которые продолжают работать через десятилетия.
current_p1_en:
Tom and Jerry, Scooby-Doo, Nu pogodi!, DuckTales. You love the classics. Not modern cartoons; the ones your parents watched too — the ones that keep working across decades.
This works because you understand: a real classic is one that survives generations. And these cartoons are exactly that.
Other people sometimes are surprised: "Tom and Jerry has no words". No words. And that's the genius — a universal language.
What's worth knowing: old cartoons often hold dated jokes or images. Learn to accept it. It's part of history, and not every moment has to meet today's standards. The art remains.

items_in_category: Чип и Дейл спешат на помощь
current_p1_ru: Губка Боб, Время приключений, Рик и Морти, Футурама. Тебя цепляли мультфильмы, которые не следовали логике. Чем абсурднее — тем лучше.
current_p1_en:
SpongeBob, Adventure Time, Rick and Morty, Futurama. What got you were cartoons that didn't follow logic. The more absurd, the better.
This works because you love the irrational. Too-logical stories bore you; you need the unexpected.
Other people sometimes tap their forehead: "how can you watch SpongeBob?". I watch. And I laugh.
What's worth knowing: "absurd" cartoons often turn out deeper than they seem. Adventure Time is a post-apocalyptic world, and its absurdity is a mask for philosophy. Learn to look deeper.

items_in_category: Чип и Дейл спешат на помощь
current_p1_ru: Черепашки-Ниндзя, Покемон, Аватар, Утиные истории. Тебя цепляли мультфильмы с экшеном. Битвы, приключения, спасение мира. Это была твоя школа храбрости.
current_p1_en:
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Pokémon, Avatar, DuckTales. What got you were cartoons with action. Battles, adventures, saving the world. This was your school of bravery.
This works because you have a need for the heroic. Not passive stories; you need the hero to act.
Other people sometimes are surprised: "you still watch Turtles?". Sometimes. And I watch with my kids — let them see too.
What's worth knowing: action cartoons often simplify morality to "good vs evil". Learn to see the simplification. The real world is more complex — and the best modern cartoons (Avatar) understand that.

current_p1_ru: Борщ, плов, пельмени, картошка. Твой comfort — постсоветская кухня. Простая, сытная, тёплая. То, что бабушка могла приготовить, и что в любое время года греет душу.
current_p1_en:
Borscht, plov, pelmeni, potatoes. Your comfort is post-Soviet food: simple, filling, warm. The kind a grandmother could make, the kind that warms you in any season.
You have a deep tie to childhood. These dishes aren't just food; they're memory. The smell and taste send you back to something warmer than the room you're in.
People sometimes ask: "don't you want something more refined?" You do. But on a bad day you need borscht, not omakase.
What's worth knowing: nostalgic dishes are often better at grandma's than at restaurants. Learn to cook them at home. Without that skill you're stuck chasing "the right one" outside, and never finding it.

current_p1_ru: Паста, пицца, mac & cheese, яичница. Твой comfort — простая итальянская и америк-итальянская кухня. Пара ингредиентов, и из них всегда что-то получается.
current_p1_en:
Pasta, pizza, mac & cheese, eggs. Your comfort is simple Italian and Italian-American food. A few ingredients, a pan, and somehow dinner appears.
You love the timeless. These dishes don't depend on fashion; they were good, and they'll stay good.
People sometimes say: "pasta is just pasta." Exactly. The strength is in the simplicity.
What's worth knowing: the "simplicity" of Italian cuisine is an illusion. A good carbonara takes understanding. Learn the basics. Without them, your "homemade pasta" is just spaghetti with jarred sauce, and that's different.

current_p1_ru: Рамен, суши, том ям, жареная курица. Твой comfort — азиатская еда. Не «попробовать что-то новое»; а вкусы, которые стали тебе родными.
current_p1_en:
Ramen, sushi, tom yum, fried chicken. Your comfort is Asian food. Not "trying something new" anymore, but flavors that became home.
You grew up in the era of globalization. Asian cuisine isn't "exotic" to you; it's part of everyday life.
People sometimes ask: "don't you eat borscht?" You do. But on a bad day you need tom yum.
What's worth knowing: real Asian cuisine in Russia is often adapted. If you love it, try going to the country. Real ramen in Japan and "ramen" at a Moscow sushi bar are different dishes.

current_p1_ru: Блины, шоколад, яичница, хачапури. Твой comfort — то, что готовится за 10 минут. Не «час у плиты»; а быстрая радость.
current_p1_en:
Blini, chocolate, eggs, khachapuri. Your comfort is what comes together in ten minutes. Not an hour at the stove — quick joy.
Your time is limited. Long cooking belongs to weekends; on weekdays, you need fast and good.
People sometimes get snobby: "blini with condensed milk again?" Again. What's wrong with that?
What's worth knowing: fast meals often become "the default" and that makes them boring. Vary them — even a simple breakfast can be done differently. Otherwise blini stop being a treat in a year.

current_p1_ru: Бургер, жареная курица, суши, пицца. Тебе нравится еда, которую можно есть руками. Не «ужин с приборами»; а быстрое, сочное, удовлетворяющее.
current_p1_en:
Burger, fried chicken, sushi, pizza. You like food you can eat with your hands. Not dinner with cutlery — fast, juicy, satisfying.
You don't have much patience for food pretension. You don't care what's "proper"; you eat what gives pleasure.
People sometimes say: "a burger is fast food." And great fast food exists. Not every expensive restaurant beats a good burger.
What's worth knowing: street food is a health question. Every day, there will be consequences. Learn to alternate. And remember — the best burgers are usually not at chains, but at niche spots.

current_p1_ru: Хачапури, пицца, mac & cheese, паста. Твой comfort — хлеб с расплавленным сыром в любых формах. Это базовое, и оно работает в любой культуре.
current_p1_en:
Khachapuri, pizza, mac & cheese, pasta. Your comfort is bread with melted cheese in any form. Basic, ancient, unbeatable.
Your relationship with food is beautifully simple. You don't need elaborate combinations; you need it filling and warm.
People sometimes call you monotonous. You call it content. Different things.
What's worth knowing: "bread with cheese" is also a serious load on the gut. If you eat it every day, problems show up over time. Learn to balance with greens, protein, vegetables.

current_p1_ru: Борщ, рамен, том ям, плов. Тебе нужен суп. Не «второе с гарниром»; а горячий бульон, который согревает изнутри.
current_p1_en:
Borscht, ramen, tom yum, plov. You need soup. Not a main with a side — hot broth that warms you from the inside.
Temperature matters to you. Cold food feels unfinished; you need heat.
People sometimes ask: "soup in summer too?" In summer too. Tom yum in summer is the best option.
What's worth knowing: soup is also an investment of time. Good borscht takes 4 hours. Either invest, or find a place that makes it right. Pre-packaged soups are not the same food.

current_p1_ru: Тирамису, панна котта, эклеры, шварцвальдский торт. Тебе ближе итальянская и западноевропейская десертная традиция. Сложные многослойные торты, кремы, мускатель и кофе.
current_p1_en:
Tiramisu, panna cotta, éclairs, Black Forest cake. You're closer to the Italian and Western European dessert tradition: layers, cream, coffee, and a little ceremony.
You love the classics. A good tiramisu is haute cuisine in dessert form.
People sometimes say: "every café has tiramisu." Yes — and most of it is bad. Good is hard to find.
What's worth knowing: Italian desserts depend heavily on quality. Bad mascarpone ruins any tiramisu. Learn to tell the difference. And don't be afraid to send back — a dessert without pleasure isn't paid for.

current_p1_ru: Макаруны, эклеры, крем-брюле, чурро. Тебе нужна французская кондитерская традиция. Это не еда; это произведение искусства.
current_p1_en:
Macarons, éclairs, crème brûlée, churros. You need the French pastry tradition. This isn't food; it's a work of art.
You have an eye for aesthetics. A macaron isn't just a treat; it's math and beauty in one bite.
People sometimes get snobby: "you're such a gourmand." Fine. What's wrong with taking pleasure in something beautiful and delicious?
What's worth knowing: French pastry is expensive. Good macarons cost. Either invest, or find a real French pâtissier in your city. They exist, you just have to look.

current_p1_ru: Пахлава, мочи, дондурма, матча-торт. Тебя цепляют восточные десерты. Японские, восточные, азиатские — другая эстетика, другая логика сладкого.
current_p1_en:
Baklava, mochi, dondurma, matcha cake. Eastern desserts pull you in: Japanese, Middle Eastern, Asian — different aesthetics, a different logic of sweetness.
You like sweetness with another temperament. European desserts are familiar; you want a different rhythm.
People sometimes don't get it: "how can you eat mochi, it's like rubber." Not rubber — bouncy. A different sensation than European cake.
What's worth knowing: Eastern desserts often need context. Matcha cake without understanding the Japanese tea ceremony is just a strange green pie. Learn the history. It changes how the food tastes.

current_p1_ru: Медовик, Наполеон, эклеры, тирамису. Тебя цепляют слоёные торты. Не «лёгкий мусс»; а серьёзные многослойные сооружения с кремом.
current_p1_en:
Medovik, Napoleon, éclairs, tiramisu. Layered cakes get you. Not light mousses — serious constructions of cream, pastry, and patience.
You love the craft. A good medovik is hours of work, and every layer tells on it.
People sometimes ask: "you prefer old cakes?" Old, yes. They earned their place.
What's worth knowing: the best layered cakes are homemade or from specialty bakeries. Chains often simplify the recipe. Learn to tell. And don't be afraid to look for "grandma's recipe" — it's usually better than any restaurant's.

current_p1_ru: Брауни, шварцвальдский, чурро, эклеры. Тебе нужен шоколад в его максимально насыщенной форме. Не «нота шоколада»; а кусок плотного, тёмного.
current_p1_en:
Brownie, Black Forest, churros, éclairs. You need chocolate in its most concentrated form. Not "a hint of chocolate"; a piece of dense, dark.
Chocolate is serious for you. Not a tea-time sweet, but a standalone food.
People sometimes ask: "one brownie is enough?" Enough. One good brownie beats several mediocre ones.
What's worth knowing: chocolate quality is the foundation. Cheap chocolate in a brownie gives a "chemical" taste. Invest in good chocolate. And remember — a real good brownie is almost liquid inside. Overdone — it's not it.

current_p1_ru: Матча, мочи, панна котта, чизкейк. Тебе нужны нежные, неагрессивные десерты. Не «шоколадная бомба»; а тонкая работа со вкусами.
current_p1_en:
Matcha, mochi, panna cotta, cheesecake. You need delicate, non-aggressive desserts. Not a "chocolate bomb"; subtle work with flavors.
Your palate is grown-up. Sweet-on-sweet bores you; you need a note, a nuance, an aftertaste.
People sometimes ask: "where's the kick?" You don't need a kick. You need a symphony.
What's worth knowing: subtle desserts require mastery. A good matcha cake is both quality of tea and technique. Learn to find true masters. Most "Japanese dessert cafés" make European interpretations, not authentic ones.

current_p1_ru: Штрудель, чурро, брауни, пахлава. Тебе нужны десерты с текстурой. Хрустящая корочка, плотный центр, контраст между разными слоями.
current_p1_en:
Strudel, churros, brownie, baklava. You need desserts with texture. Crispy crust, dense center, contrast between layers.
Texture matters to you as much as flavor: how it crunches, melts, breaks, disappears.
People sometimes can't tell the difference: "it's the same thing." Not the same. A good strudel has thin, almost transparent dough; a bad one is thick and greasy.
What's worth knowing: textural desserts go soft fast. If a strudel sat in the fridge for a day, its texture is gone. Eat fresh. And remember — the best of this type are made to order, not in mass production.

category_name: Где ты бы встретил Новый год
current_p1_ru: Дома с оливье и сериалами, в горах у костра, в Праге, в Амстердаме. Тебе нужен Новый год как камерный момент — близкие, тёплый свет, без шума.
current_p1_en:
Home with olivier salad and TV shows, mountains by a fire, Prague, Amsterdam. You need New Year's as an intimate moment: close people, warm light, no noise.
You understand the main value of New Year's is who, not where. You choose by people, not scenery.
People sometimes ask: "home again?" Again. And every time, it feels like the best decision of the year.
What's worth knowing: cozy New Year's works if you have someone. If you plan "home with close ones" but they aren't around — that's not coziness, it's loneliness. Be honest with yourself. Sometimes accepting an invitation beats forcing the cozy plan.
